text.description_html:
AHI SIG103/SIG203PA-902/120, Sapporo Stainless Steel Lever with Square Rose and Spindle

The SIG103 Satin Stainless Steel Sapporo Lever has a modern square rose and a round barrel style grip. This stainless steel door lever has a modern contemporary design--flat at one end, but with a rounded curve at the mounting 90 degree base--for an easy touch of sophistication. The lever is all stainless steel, making it resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasions. Durable in appearance and function even after years of use on your home or office. This set is packaged with 2 levers, 2 rosettes, and a spindle. It does not include a latch, subrose or strike plate.

Specifications of the Stainless Steel Sapporo Lever Pair with Spindle:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Lever Length: 5-1/2" (140 mm)
  • Lever Thickness: 3/4" (19 mm)
  • Projection: 2-3/8" (60 mm)
  • Spindle Width: 5/16" (8 mm)
  • Rose Length: 2-3/16" (55 mm) squared
  • Rose Thickness: 7/16" (11 mm)

Package Includes: a pair (2) SIG103 levers, a pair (2) of SIG203 55mm square roses, and (1) 8mm x 120mm spindle

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
